rationale: The implementation delta is that the fixed version performs node-state updates and either zonelist rebuilding or per-zone page-cache updates only when at least one page was actually onlined; the vulnerable version performs the zonelist/page-cache action even when onlined_pages is zero. The Logic section does not specify this zero-pages condition. Its statements that the function checks zone population, may require or trigger a zonelist rebuild, updates zone statistics, and notifies/unlocks describe behavior shared at an abstract level by both versions.
